data.exact_reserve_text: Underwriting performance has been further supplemented by favourable development from prior accident years. Due to a light incurred claims development on short tail lines the Syndicate has released reserves of GBP 2.3m (2013: GBP 4.5m) from Property. The Syndicate also experienced light incurred claims development and a release of claims provision in prior years in relation to Professional Lines and Accident & Health business, resulting in favourable prior year development of GBP 3.4m (2013: GBP 5.0m) and GBP 2.3m (2013: loss GBP 0.4m) respectively.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2012 reported a total prior year reserve release of GBP 8.0 million in 2014, driven by favourable claims development across multiple lines of business. This included a release of GBP 2.3 million from Property reserves due to light incurred claims development on short tail lines. Professional Lines also saw favourable prior year development, contributing a release of GBP 3.4 million, while Accident & Health business contributed a release of GBP 2.3 million from prior year claims provisions. The overall favourable development was also attributed to a reduction in the frequency and severity of risk loss activity experienced in prior years.
